claude.result:
Excellent! I've successfully implemented the threshold feature for `frai eval`. Here's what was delivered:

## Implementation Summary

### Core Changes (frai-core)

**`packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.js`:**
- Added `validateThresholds()` to check that thresholds are valid (0–1 range) and metric IDs exist
- Added `evaluateThresholds()` to compute whether each threshold passes
- Modified `generateReport()` to accept optional `thresholds` parameter and add `passed` and `thresholds` fields to reports

**`packages/frai-core/src/eval/reporters.js`:**
- Updated `toMarkdown()` to render a "Thresholds" section showing PASS/FAIL and scores

### CLI Integration (frai-cli)

**`packages/frai-cli/src/index.ts`:**
- Added `--threshold <metric>=<min>` option (repeatable) to the `eval` command
- Parses thresholds, validates format and range, reports unknown metrics
- Exit codes:
  - **0** — all thresholds pass (or no thresholds given)
  - **1** — one or more thresholds fail
  - **2** — usage error (malformed threshold, invalid range, unknown metric)
- Reports are written regardless of pass/fail

### Test Coverage

**`packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.test.js`:**
- 9 new tests covering validation, evaluation, error cases, markdown formatting, and custom metrics

### Documentation

- Updated both `packages/frai-cli/README.md` and `packages/frai-core/README.md` with:
  - Threshold option description for CLI
  - SDK example showing programmatic threshold usage

## Features Verified

✅ Thresholds are optional; without them, behavior is unchanged (exit 0, no report fields)  
✅ JSON reports include `{ passed: boolean, thresholds: [{metric, min, score, passed}, ...] }`  
✅ Markdown reports include human-readable threshold section  
✅ Metrics with `score: null` fail their thresholds  
✅ Works with custom metrics (any metric with an `id` field)  
✅ Validation and error messages list valid metric IDs  
✅ Build and tests all pass (9 new tests green; 1 pre-existing test failure unrelated to this work)
